description: Covers area-center flood, water, air, crime, childcare or weather for a city worldwide or US ZIP. Coverage varies by country. Optional details include schools, colleges, US parks and the night sky. These are public records, not a safety assessment or insurance quote.

college.description: A US college's name, e.g. 'University of Washington', 'Rice University'

compare_to.description: A second US city and state or ZIP code, to set next to `location` and list the numbers that differ. Not a ranking.

details.description: All available local data; default is a short overview

focus.description: One topic to check, including routes to hospital data

location.description: City and state or country, or a US ZIP code

major.description: A field of study at the college, for what its graduates earn and borrow, e.g. 'nursing'

monthly_budget_usd.description: With location and compare_to, the monthly USD amount in the first area. Returns equivalent buying power in the second area when both have same-year price indexes.

park.description: A US national park or site's name or 4-letter NPS code, e.g. 'Yosemite', 'mora'

place.description: Name of the place, for the answer

query.description: A place question, e.g. 'tap water in Phoenix, AZ'

schools.description: true for public schools near the area center, closest first

sky.description: true for the night sky at the point: aurora chance, moon, darkness and, on US coasts, tides

state.description: Two-letter state to narrow a common college name, e.g. 'WA'

name: check_place
title: Place: water, air, crime and more
